items.say: Sir Clank the knight tidied up the playroom. He put a potion on the shelf and a key in the toy box. Under the bed, he found a chest and a sword, both covered in dust. Then he lay down for a nap. Which one of these was not in the story?

Zazz the wizard packed a bag for a trip to the beach. He put in a boot and a map. He wanted a bell and a gem too, but there was no more room. At the last minute, he squeezed in a coin. Tap everything Zazz packed.

There was a big party at the castle last night. Dash the fox wanted to come, but she had to work. Pounce the cat arrived late and stayed to the end. Zazz the wizard forgot all about it and stayed home. Sir Clank the knight was sick in bed and could not come. Puff the dragon brought a huge cake. Tap everyone who was at the party.

Dash the fox moved to a new home across the river. She loaded a bell and a book onto the cart. There was no room for her egg or her flag, so they stayed behind. She took a map as well. In the rush, she forgot all about her gem. Tap everything Dash left behind.

Zip the robot had a stall at the market. By lunch time, he had sold a shield and a bell. A farmer bought a sword. At the end of the day, only a key was left on the table. Which one of these was not in the story?

Sir Clank the knight packed a bag for a trip to the beach. He picked up a shield, but then he put it down again. So he put in a key and a sword. He also packed a star and a potion. He looked at a ring, but he left it on the bed. Tap everything Sir Clank packed.

There was a big party at the castle last night. Zazz the wizard wanted to come, but he had to work. Pounce the cat came early and helped with the food. Hoot the owl arrived late and stayed to the end. Zip the robot got lost and never got there. Dash the fox danced all night long. Tap everyone who was at the party.

Sir Clank the knight moved to a new home across the river. In the rush, he forgot all about his gem. He loaded a torch, a potion, and a flag onto the cart. There was no room for his hat or his crown, so they stayed behind. Tap everything Sir Clank left behind.

Sir Clank the knight had a very silly dream. In the dream, a boot was chasing a drum around the castle. A potion was singing a song, and a star was dancing on the table. Then he woke up. Which one of these was not in the dream?
Dash the fox packed a bag for a long boat ride. First, she packed a book. She wanted a gem and a hat as well, but they would not fit. Then she added a bell and a mushroom. Tap everything Dash packed.

There was a big party at the castle last night. Dash the fox came early and helped with the food. Boo the ghost got lost and never got there. Hoot the owl brought a huge cake. Puff the dragon danced all night long. Pounce the cat arrived late and stayed to the end. Tap everyone who was at the party.

Puff the dragon moved to a new home across the river. He loaded a hat onto the cart. There was no room for his ring, so it stayed behind. In the rush, he forgot all about his drum and his egg. He did take a sword and a boot. Tap everything Puff left behind.

Pounce the cat climbed up into the dusty attic. Behind the door, she saw a crown. On the floor lay a boot and a potion. Hanging from the roof was a shield. She sneezed three times and climbed back down. Which one of these was not in the attic?

Zazz the wizard packed a bag for a long boat ride. He put in a torch and a shield. He wanted a crown and a hat too, but there was no more room. At the last minute, he squeezed in a drum and a book. Tap everything Zazz packed.

Sir Clank the knight arrived late and stayed to the end. Boo the ghost came early and helped with the food. Dash the fox forgot all about it and stayed home. Tap everyone who was at the party.

Zazz the wizard moved to a new home across the river. He loaded a shield and a heart onto the cart. There was no room for his boot or his star, so they stayed behind. He took a potion as well. In the rush, he forgot all about his ring. Tap everything Zazz left behind.

Boo the ghost tidied up the playroom. He put a gem on the shelf and a mushroom in the toy box. Under the bed, he found a bell and a boot, both covered in dust. Then he lay down for a nap. Which one of these was not in the story?

Hoot the owl packed a bag for a night at the castle. She picked up a map, but then she put it down again. So she put in a boot and a drum. She also packed a sword. She looked at a key, but she left it on the bed. Tap everything Hoot packed.
